description: This file contains utility functions related to grouped matrix multiplication (GEMM) operations in PyTorch's ATen library. It includes functions for validating inputs, creating output tensors, and fallback implementations for grouped matrix multiplication with support for batching and offsets.

methods.description: Creates an output tensor suited for grouped GEMM operations, considering batch sizes and stride alignments.

methods.description: Validates the input tensors, including shape, dtype, and strides, for grouped matrix multiplication.

methods.description: Determines the output data type for grouped matrix multiplication, ensuring consistency.
